entities.name: Kitahimbwa of Bunyoro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kitahimbwa was born in 1869 and was Omukama of Bunyoro from 1896 to 1902 in Bunyoro, in what is now Uganda. At approximately 11 years old, Kitahimbwa was installed as a puppet monarch by the British while his father, Kabalega, was still actively fighting colonial forces in the north.
